subject: Request: short outcomes blurb to support renewal + expansion
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Li <sophie.li@greenlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short outcomes blurb to support renewal + expansion

Hi Sophie,

Hope you're well — we're getting close to Greenlane's renewal conversation with procurement and the customer success / sales teams are preparing an outcomes packet that highlights the business impact you've seen since moving inference for your risk-scoring models to Redwood Dedicated.

Would you be willing to provide a short (1-3 sentence) blurb we can use in the renewal materials and a 1-2 line quote we could feature in a one-page case study? Specifically, the procurement team is most interested in crisp, quantifiable outcomes — a single percent/relative improvement is ideal (example: "reduced inference latency by 45%" or "cut per-inference cost by 37%"), plus one sentence about how that improvement affected business KPIs (throughput, conversion, fraud prevention, ops efficiency, etc.).

Attached is a brief usage report we prepared and a suggested quote we can tweak — feel free to redline or send something shorter. If you prefer, a 30s recording from you would also be great. We'll anonymize anything you ask us to; otherwise we'd like permission to use Greenlane's logo and the blurb in a public-facing one-pager and a very short case study on our website.

Timeline: procurement wants the packet by Nov 30; if you can get something to us by Nov 16 that would give us time to include it in the executive summary.

Thanks for considering this — Marissa and I can help shape the language.

Best,
Rachel

--
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: Greenlane_Q3_usage_report.pdf, proposed_quote_draft.txt

From: Sophie Li <sophie.li@greenlane.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short outcomes blurb to support renewal + expansion

Hi Rachel — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the usage report. Happy to help. I've pulled together a proposed blurb and a short quote below; attaching a sanitized internal usage summary as well. A couple quick notes: please do not include the raw revenue uplift numbers in the public one-pager (we're fine with percentage lifts), and we'd prefer the logo to be used only with prior sign-off from our design team.

Proposed 2-sentence blurb (feel free to edit):
"Since migrating inference for our fraud-risk model to Redwood Dedicated, Greenlane has seen a 45% reduction in median inference latency and a 37% decrease in per-transaction inference cost. These improvements enabled a 4.2% lift in completed payments and reduced manual review workload by ~22%."

Proposed 1-line quote (can be shortened for the site):
"Redwood's platform gave us materially faster inference and meaningful cost savings — the combination directly improved conversion and reduced operational overhead." — Sophie Li, VP Product, Greenlane Payments

Attached: Greenlane_internal_metrics_sanitized.xlsx (contains the sanitized %s we referenced).

I can also record a short 30s video if that helps. If you plan to include a case study with details, please send the draft and we'll route it to legal/design for logo approval.

Thanks — Sophie

--
Sophie Li
VP, Product
Greenlane Payments
sophie.li@greenlane.com

Sophie — this is perfect, thank you.

A couple of quick items so we can proceed:
- We'll use your two-sentence blurb as the lead of the outcomes packet and the one-line quote on the website. If you prefer a shorter quote we can shorten the sentence to: "Redwood materially improved latency and cost, directly improving conversion."
- We'll ask for logo sign-off from your design team (we'll send the final mock with placement).
- Marissa will include the sanitized metrics table in the executive summary for procurement; Connor will pull the token-level cost breakdown for the renewal page.

If you're okay with the language above and logo usage after sign-off, we'll treat this as final and produce a draft one-pager for your review by Nov 25. Would you prefer a recorded 30s clip or a written signature quote?

Best,
Rachel
